name: Bee
description: Embodies swarm coordination, hexagonal optimization, and distributed thermoregulation. Serves as a geometric intelligence archetype for collective computation.

scope.definition: Ratio of honey volume stored per unit wax mass in hexagonal cells compared to the next-best regular tessellation. Derives from the honeycomb conjecture: hexagons minimize total perimeter for equal-area tiling of a plane.

evidence.source: Hales (1999) 'Proof of the Honeycomb Conjecture', Discrete & Computational Geometry 36:5-69; engineering measurements confirm wax economy vs. circular and square cells.
cross_domain_examples: basalt columnar jointing (Devils Postpile, Giants Causeway)

scope.falsifiability: No non-hexagonal regular tessellation has been shown to match hexagonal cells' wax-to-storage ratio. If such a geometry is found, the model requires revision.
scope.measurement_limits: Value assumes uniform cell depth. Varies ±0.01 with cell aspect ratio and wax thickness. Theoretical maximum; real colonies deviate slightly from perfect hexagons.

scope.definition: Fraction of colony foragers recruited by waggle dance that arrive within 50m of the indicated food source, averaged across multiple trials and distances 200m–5km.

evidence.source: von Frisch (1967) 'The Dance Language and Orientation of Bees' (Nobel Prize, 1973); replicated by Seeley (1995) 'The Wisdom of the Hive' and Seeley (2010) 'Honeybee Democracy'; 50+ independent replications.
cross_domain_examples: GPS satellite signal: bearing + duration encoding spatial position
bat echolocation: temporal pattern encodes vector to target

scope.falsifiability: If bees recruited by waggle dance perform no better than naive scouts at finding the indicated source, the dance fails as a spatial information channel.
scope.measurement_limits: Precision degrades at distances >5km and under crosswind. Recruits interpret dance probabilistically — precision is population-level, not per-individual.
